title: Moesha

Things get tense at the Mitchell house when Frank discovers Moesha has been taking birth control pills – and he’s the last to know.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E6 — Just Above My Head
Moesha finds her history teacher’s remarks racially offensive, but fears that confronting him might affect her grade and cost Niecy her scholarship.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E7 — A Den Is A Terrible Thing To Waste
A well-intentioned Moesha intervenes to try and stop her once-popular hangout, The Den, from being sold to a commercial developer, unaware that Andell stands to make a great deal of money on its sale.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E8 — Isn’t She Lovely?
Hakeem and Moesha’s friendship takes an interesting turn after he surprises her with an expensive necklace to wear to a homecoming dance she’s attending with someone else.

S3 E2 — The Talk Show
Sandra's show-biz career as a talk-show host threatens the friendship of the whole group when she questions them on the air about sex in the eighties.

S3 E3 — There Goes The Building
Rose receives an offer to buy her building from a real estate magnate whose plan to renovate means tearing down 227.

S3 E4 — The Sing-Off
In charge of the big choir competition, Mary must make room in her have for the visiting choir's deacon, who is notoriously arrogant, thoughtless and pushy.

S3 E5 — And Baby Makes Three
Alarmed by Brenda and her friends' casual attitude about teen pregnancy, Mary uses some unusual methods to teach them a lesson about parenting that they'll never forget.

Following her divorce, Eddie's mom arrives for a visit that coincides with one from Malcolm's dad.

description:

Malcolm faces a difficult decision in order to get Simone to keep making her extraordinary cookies.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

Eddie ignores Nicolette's premonition and agrees to fill in for an injured race car driver.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E22 — Pot Luck
Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.
